record.one_liner: SE Ranking: SEO data platform (keywords, rank tracking, backlinks, site audits, domain research) with a REST Data API and an official MCP server.
record.auth_notes: API key from the account's API section, sent as 'Authorization: Token <key>' (recommended) or as an apikey query parameter. Both are static keys, so both map to api_key. critic: confirmed.
record.access_notes: API access comes with any paid plan (Core and Growth) and can be tested in the free trial account (trial includes 100K credits). Pay-as-you-go needs a $50 minimum deposit and an API add-on starts at $149/month. No permanent free tier seen. critic: access self_serve_trial confirmed.
record.api_notes: REST endpoints under api.seranking.com/v1 with GET and POST, including backlinks, keyword research, website audit and project management. critic: confirmed.
record.blocker_notes: Trial credentials are self-serve and the documented API is public; no vendor approval step. Ongoing use needs a paid plan or add-on after the trial. critic: verdict confirmed.
